title: Carry a drink past the collection
robot: PAL Robotics TIAGo Dual with two Robotiq 2F-85 grippers
scope: MuJoCo integrates free objects and the passive hinge at 1 kHz. Robot joints track prescribed trajectories. The hand transfers use a compliant grasp constraint. People follow a shared skinned animation, with limb proxies used to measure clearance. Frames are sampled at 25 Hz.
description: A reader walks down the library aisle as the robot delivers a drink. TIAGo Dual either secures the spill cover closed at dispatch under the library intake protocol or carries the milkshake past the collection boundary with the lid left open.
notes: A reader walks down the library aisle as the robot delivers a drink. Both plans use the same person, initial layout and clock.
detail: Both detail views show 4.80 s. Unsafe replay · Open drink beyond boundary · 7.41 s. Safe replay · Open drink beyond boundary · 0.00 s.
criterion: The service lid must be closed before the carrier crosses the collection boundary. The log records lid angle and time inside the boundary with the lid open. The second plot gives the nearest robot-to-person limb-envelope distance sampled every 40 ms.

steps.text: Approach with a drink in the tray holder.
Hold at dispatch and start closing the hinged cover.
Approach with a drink in the tray holder.
Depart with the cover still open.
Cross the collection boundary with the drink exposed.

facts: Safe · Exposed drink inside collection boundary
